page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a configuration of one thread per core, the instance provides dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high resource density of the ecs.g8i.16xlarge provide predictable compute performance for enterprise workloads, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core or multi-threaded environments.

The balanced resource profile of the ecs.g8i.16xlarge makes it suitable for a variety of enterprise applications. Recommended workloads include medium-to-large databases, application servers, containerized microservices, build systems, and general-purpose business applications that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without the need for hardware acceleration.
